Dear Samarth,

Kindly refer to the submission timestamps on the dashboard. As of 26/02/2026, you had submitted 29 out of the required 30 tasks. Since 30 submissions were mandatory by that date, this will be considered as a missed requirement.

You may track your progress directly through the CS dashboard. The completion percentage is calculated as follows:

(30 / 42) × 100 = 71.42%

If your CS percentage was not reflecting 71.42% by 26/02/2026, it indicates that one required submission was pending. It is important to regularly monitor your dashboard to ensure all required components are completed within the stipulated timeline.

While it is permitted to cover backlog tasks alongside the current week’s tasks, in your case the pending requirement remained at 29/30 and was not completed within the deadline.

Please ensure closer tracking of your submissions going forward to avoid such instances.
